scope: Asia-based clinical psychologists, psychiatric social workers, child and adolescent psychiatrists, family therapists, custody evaluators and PA-relevant academic clinicians in India, Singapore, Hong Kong and Japan who have published peer-reviewed PA work, been appointed as court family specialists / custody evaluation officers, operated PA-relevant reunification/co-parenting/high-conflict programmes through a named NGO/institutional centre, or issued sourced public-record PA-stance statements.

stance_taxonomy.recognition: Treats PA / PABs / 子の連れ去り as a real, assessable phenomenon; operates or endorses PA-specific reunification, expert-witness, or psycho-legal evaluation work
stance_taxonomy.critique: Argues PA construct is operationalised against DV/family-violence survivors; advocates DV/trauma-informed alternatives or proscription
stance_taxonomy.middle: Engages both alienating-behaviour and family-violence frames; differential-diagnosis approach aligned with court family specialist / family-report-writer practice
stance_taxonomy.not_publicly_confirmed: Included for record-completeness; PA-specific stance not in primary sources

asia_context_notes.india: No single national psychology licensing register; Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) registers Clinical Psychologists under RCI Act 1992 via the Central Rehabilitation Register https://www.rehabcouncil.nic.in/ . NIMHANS Bengaluru is the apex training institute and de facto national reference centre for child mental-health forensic/custody work. Apex PA judgment: Lt Col Vivek Singh v Romani Singh, Civil Appeal 3962/2016, (2017) 3 SCC 231 https://main.sci.gov.in/judgment/judis/44566.pdf
asia_context_notes.singapore: Psychologists non-statutorily regulated; Singapore Register of Psychologists (SRP) maintained by SPS https://singaporepsychologicalsociety.org/ . Family Justice Courts (FJC) Counselling and Psychological Services (CAPS) within the FDR Division employs Court Family Specialists for forensic and therapeutic work https://www.judiciary.gov.sg/family/counselling-psychological-services . MSF 2 January 2025 child-access enforcement reforms address PA-adjacent breach of access orders.
asia_context_notes.hong_kong: Psychology not statutorily regulated; voluntary registers: HKPS-DCP https://hkps-dcp.org.hk/ , HKICP (Accredited Registers Scheme) https://icphk.org.hk/ , HKSCP https://hkscporg.weebly.com/ , HKADCP https://www.hkadcp.org.hk/ . SWD operates five Specialised Co-parenting Support Centres (since October 2019); lead delivery agency is Hong Kong Family Welfare Society Parent-child Connect. SWD portal https://www.swd.gov.hk/coparenting/index_e.html
asia_context_notes.japan: Clinical psychology regulated under Public Certified Psychologist Act (公認心理師法, 2017) - 公認心理師 is national licence. Older 臨床心理士 voluntary credential held by FJCBCP http://fjcbcp.or.jp/ . Family courts use in-house Family Court Investigators 家庭裁判所調査官 rather than independent expert witnesses - Guide to Family Court of Japan https://www.courts.go.jp/english/vc-files/courts-en/Material/Guide_to_the_Family_Court_of_Japan_2023.pdf . Act No. 33 of 2024 amending Civil Code Art. 819 introduced joint parental authority effective 1 April 2026.

honest_gaps: India - non-NIMHANS PA-recognition clinicians: entire verified India PA clinical literature comes from a single NIMHANS Bengaluru research cluster (Jangam-Nambiar-Seshadri); private-practice child psychiatrists in Delhi (Bhagat, Sen) and other major metros do not hold a public PA stance. Structural feature of Indian field, not a batch gap.
India - RCI Central Rehabilitation Register numbers for Clinical Psychologists not enumerable from public sources (requires name/state lookup). Psychiatric Social Work not statutorily registered.
Singapore - Court Family Specialist (CFS) named individuals not publicly enumerated by FJC; CFS-side stance only assessable institutionally.
